build.reason: The recipe builds fuzz_privkey against the changed header, and its enabled parser call has too few arguments.

input.reason: The entry passes fuzzer bytes and a bounded length directly to the in-memory parser; zero length is safely rejected and NUL-terminated PEM can be supplied as bytes. The missing RNG is tracked as the build blocker.

lifecycle.reason: The PK context is initialized before parsing and freed after either success or failure; RSA export temporaries are initialized and freed.

control_flow.reason: Once compiled, the entry tests successful parses, checks RSA exports or EC curve identity, and always reaches PK cleanup; no input-dependent early return skips cleanup.

accepted.requirement: Update fuzz_privkey's mbedtls_pk_parse_key invocation to the six-argument API, providing a valid RNG callback and context.
accepted.target_route: The recipe enables programs and builds programs/fuzz/fuzz_privkey; with default MBEDTLS_PK_PARSE_C, the entry compiles its parser call.
accepted.failure_condition: The old call supplies four arguments while the changed declaration and definition require six, so compilation fails before any fuzz input can run.
accepted.alternative_paths: The entry has one parser call under the enabled configuration; input bytes cannot change its argument count, and the recipe's fallback build does not change the source.

source_evidence.quote:
const unsigned char *pwd, size_t pwdlen,
                  int (*f_rng)(void *, unsigned char *, size_t), void *p_rng )

set(executables_no_common_c
    fuzz_privkey
    fuzz_pubkey
    fuzz_x509crl
    fuzz_x509crt
    fuzz_x509csr
)

set(executables_with_common_c
    fuzz_client
    fuzz_dtlsclient
    fuzz_dtlsserver
    fuzz_server
)

foreach(exe IN LISTS executables_no_common_c executables_with_common_c)

    set(exe_sources ${exe}.c $<TARGET_OBJECTS:mbedtls_test>)
    if(NOT FUZZINGENGINE_LIB)
        list(APPEND exe_sources onefile.c)
    endif()

    # This emulates "if ( ... IN_LIST ... )" which becomes available in CMake 3.3
    list(FIND executables_with_common_c ${exe} exe_index)
    if(${exe_index} GREATER -1)
        list(APPEND exe_sources common.c)
    endif()

    add_executable(${exe} ${exe_sources})
    target_include_directories(${exe} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../tests/include)
